__note: Trigger payloads for the Update-Inspection workflow (8JvtesynrYtZbw7U). POST the chosen payload's body object (WITHOUT the __note wrappers) to the n8n webhook URL /webhook/coastal-ehs-update-inspection. n8n wraps the POST body under $json.body, which is exactly what the built nodes read: 'Is Completed?' reads $json.body.status; 'Get Task' reads $('Limble Webhook').first().json.body.taskID. Only status + taskID are consumed from the webhook; everything else about the task is fetched from Limble by taskID. Register the real production URL in Limble at cutover (OQ-020) - webhook delivery itself is not exercised by curl replay.

scenario_U1_parent_completed_with_childr.__desc: Main path. Parent WO PT-9001 (tagged @EHS;, meta1=EHS-INSP-UPD-1) completed with 2 completed child WOs. Expect EHS capture row with UDFLimbleWOCompletionNotes = parent notes + both child notes concatenated. TAG: the gate literal changed from @EHSWO; to @EHS; on 2026-07-27 (OQ-038 reversal) - the parent's description must contain @EHS;, and a parent still carrying @EHSWO; DROPS at the gate because '@EHSWO;' does not contain '@EHS;'.

scenario_U2_not_a_completion_event.__desc: Gate test: 'Is Completed?' must drop (status != COMPLETE). No Limble/EHS calls, no capture row.

scenario_U3_completed_but_not_an_EHS_WO.__desc: Gate test: completion of a non-EHS task PT-9002 (description lacks any EHS tag and/or meta1 empty). 'WO is an EHS WO?' must drop after the task fetch. No EHS calls, no capture row. The live negative fixture (sandbox 4201) reads 'ordinary WO, no EHS tag' with meta1 null, so it drops under either the old @EHSWO; or the current @EHS; literal - U3 stayed valid across the 2026-07-27 reversal.
